name: tpch_sf_100
description: Indexes the TPC-H sf=100 dataset (8 tables, 866M rows) and runs the 22 TPC-H queries as PPL against the analytics engine

name: tpch_sf_100-query-only
description: Runs the 22 TPC-H queries against an ALREADY LOADED sf=100 cluster. No indexing, no index deletion. This is the procedure to use for iteration -- re-indexing 866M rows per run is impractical.
